clips.title: The story
paras: Encroachment is a Horde quest directed by Gar'Thok at Razor Hill in central Durotar. It charges champions with striking deep into the western bramble dens to eliminate the entrenched Razormane quilboar threatening the borders of the young orc nation.

When Thrall led the orcs to Kalimdor and founded Durotar, they found much of the harsh, arid land already inhabited by the Razormane quilboar. These aggressive, boar-like creatures proved a constant thorn in the side of the new settlement. Through sustained military efforts, the Horde drove back the bulk of their numbers, yet fortified pockets of Razormane continue to cling stubbornly to their thorned redoubts west of Razor Hill.

Gar'Thok, an officer stationed at Razor Hill, oversees the effort to purge the lingering Razormane threat once and for all. He tasks seasoned defenders with striking directly into the western bramble camps to eliminate their scouts, warriors, and dustrunners. For Gar'Thok and the Horde leadership, allowing the quilboar any foothold near Razor Hill invites disaster, and striking them here is seen as the first step toward securing Kalimdor.

Eliminating the quilboar defenders clears the path for Horde forces to torch the bramble dens, preventing the Razormane from reclaiming the western foothills. By burning these structures to the ground, the Horde removes an enduring menace and secures the western perimeter of Durotar, safeguarding vital supply roads between Razor Hill and the wider realm.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When we arrived, the Razormane quilboars possessed much of the land, and proved a thorn in our sides. Through our efforts we have driven out the largest part of their numbers, but still they remain well-fortified in some areas.

It has gone on long enough, however. For our own protection, we cannot allow the Razormane any hold in our lands. Their camps can be found to the west of here. Look for the brambles and you will find them. Today we drive them from Durotar, tomorrow, perhaps from all of Kalimdor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I will pass along word that the quilboars have been removed from their lairs, and that their structures may be set to fire. The removal of the Razormane from Durotar brings us closer to fully securing the borders of our new homeland.
